evidence.summary: The US Entity List names it as “China Electronics Technology Group Corporation 29 (CETC 29) Research Institute”, one of the research institutes of China Electronics Technology Group Corporation (CETC). CETC is one of the state-owned defence-industry groups that SASTIND lists, and CETC lists the institute among its member units.

The US Commerce Department listed it in August 2014, finding reasonable cause to believe that it was involved in the illicit procurement of commodities and technologies for unauthorized military end use in China.
It belongs to CETC, which describes itself as a key state-owned enterprise administered directly by the central government.
